name: aetherstudio
description: Production-ready collaborative IDE with real-time code synchronization, interactive terminal execution, and AI-powered assistance

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.setup: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.format: npm run format -w backend && npm run format -w frontend
